description: US Treasury note / bond conventions: semiannual coupons accruing Actual/Actual (ICMA) on unadjusted half-year periods, coupon dates generated backward from maturity, payment Following, settlement T+1 on the UnitedStatesGovernmentBond calendar, redemption 100, yield quoted Actual/Actual (ICMA) Compounded Semiannual. Trade-only preset (fixed_rate_bond); the discount curve comes from the market.
provenance: 31 CFR 356 Appendix B, Formulas and Tables (semiannual interest, half-year periods, actual days in the half-year, semiannual compounding of the yield): https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356 (LII mirror of the e-CFR; the ecfr.gov page redirected to a bot check and treasurydirect.gov did not answer from the build environment); Actual/Actual (ICMA) as implemented by QuantLib 1.41 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.41/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp

field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.settlement_days: T+1: regular-way settlement of US Treasury securities is the next business day (market practice; the regulation prices to the settlement date) (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.calendar: UnitedStatesGovernmentBond: the engine's Calendar enum for the US government bond market (QuantLib UnitedStates::GovernmentBond) (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.conventi: Unadjusted: coupon periods run calendar date to calendar date; accrual is on the unadjusted dates (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.terminat: Unadjusted: the maturity date is the calendar date (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.date_gen: Backward: coupon dates are generated from the maturity date, a short first period if any (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.end_of_m: false: coupon dates keep the maturity date's day of month (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.frequency: Semiannual: interest is paid on a semiannual basis, the regular interest period is a full half-year (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.accrual_day_count: Actual/Actual (ICMA): the actual number of days in the half-year over the actual days of the period, compounding on the coupon dates; the engine's DayCounter ActualActualISMA = QuantLib 1.41 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.41/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.payment_conventio: Following: a coupon falling on a non-business day is paid on the next business day; accrual itself is Unadjusted (market practice, stated here as such: the cited source https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356 fixes the accrual and yield formulae, not the payment-date adjustment)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.redemption: 100: redeemed at par (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.day_counter: Actual/Actual (ICMA): the actual number of days in the half-year over the actual days of the period, compounding on the coupon dates; the engine's DayCounter ActualActualISMA = QuantLib 1.41 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.41/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.compounding: Compounded: the quoted yield compounds once per coupon period (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.frequency: Semiannual: interest is paid on a semiannual basis, the regular interest period is a full half-year; the yield compounds at the coupon frequency (31 CFR 356 Appendix B, https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356)
